source: Dave's Picks Volume 40 | Dave's Picks Volume 41
note: The U.S. Blues encore comes from Dave's Picks Volume 41, not Volume 40. Volume 40 carries this night but left the encore off, and Volume 41 — a 1977 release — issued it as its single bonus track, saying so outright: "'U.S. Blues', the encore from the July 19, 1990 show at Deer Creek Music Center. This song had been omitted from Dave's Picks Volume 40 due to lack of space." So the show is stitched from two volumes of the same series, twenty-one years apart in the music and one in the release schedule. Same pattern as 19691226, whose Cold Rain and Snow Volume 43 held over to Volume 44.
